nodes.name: parity_action_space
nodes.premise: Assert policy outputs == env action count before any training. Drift evidence: PolicyNet 7 vs decode 0-8 hid brake actions; fixed to 9. Dota2: match hybrid action-space size. Rocket: match gimbal/throttle bins.

nodes.name: clean_eval_selection
nodes.premise: Never rank on noisy rollouts. Re-eval top-K candidates deterministic (noise 0, 3 eps); elites/saves/early-stop on clean fitness. Drift evidence: 40pct-noise fitness claimed 1.5 laps, true policy 0 laps.

nodes.name: diversity_pressure
nodes.premise: Entropy and unique-action tiebreak in rank key demotes single-action collapse. Drift evidence: all-action-6 wall crash at 246,142. Key shape is task, activity, survival, unique, entropy, minus risk.

nodes.name: activity_gate
nodes.premise: Rank activity before survival so parking or timeout sitting cannot win. Drift evidence: brake-sit 4000 steps outranked movers until dist metric added. Dota2: reward turtling only with map control. Rocket: hovering is not landing.

nodes.name: reward_asymmetry
nodes.premise: Terminal failure penalty must exceed max achievable bonus or suicide loops pay. Drift evidence: lap 750 vs off-track 1000, no double bonus. Rocket: crash penalty must exceed landing bonus intermediates.

nodes.name: verify_standard
nodes.premise: Claim results only from deterministic eval with trajectory log: noise 0, fixed seed, per-step CSV with positions, crash-point summary. Drift evidence: traj_eval.csv exposed 0-lap truth behind 1.5-lap noisy claim.

nodes.name: ci_hygiene
nodes.premise: Training entry must be CI-safe: no input prompts, model paths anchored to code dir, seed and duration flags, stdout guard under pytest. Drift evidence: train hygiene v1 plus viz-seconds auto-exit.
